Help us wish @TaranaBurke a happy birthday!

Thank you for your leadership in bringing a voice to women and girls all over the world. You changed the world, and continue to do so each day. #MeToo

Art: Kelly Malka (bykellymalka) https://t.co/cq92GbKOdm

Here's our message to Senators:

In this #MeToo era, people all over the country are finally starting to listen to and believe survivors of sexual assault. We expect the same of our Senators. Listen to and believe Christine Blasey Ford. Listen to and believe survivors everywhere.
Thank you, @TaranaBurke, for your leadership! #MeToo https://t.co/YsxGVrb14V
